en: A multi-view color postcard with a yellow border featuring several photographs of a rural mountainous region. The central image shows a traditional large wooden house with a steep roof, decorated with flowers, and a woman and child in traditional dress standing in front. Surrounding images show rolling green hills, small villages, a public swimming pool, and countryside scenes, all labeled with German captions. The title at the bottom highlights the town of Aitern in the Black Forest at the foot of the Belchen mountain.
